import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_52/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_52/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_52/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_52/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
df4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_52/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# UNION all source tables
df = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2, df3, df4], ignore_index=True)

# FILTER out rows where any of the columns have NaN values (to remove all-NaN rows)
df = df[df['Module'].notna() & df['Time'].notna() & df['Date'].notna() & df['Room'].notna() & df['Room_Capacity'].notna() & df['Registered_Students'].notna()]

# Write the final output with exact column names as target schema
df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_52/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
